purpose: Standardise capture and analysis so between-subject movement-rhythm comparisons are made using the same physical and analytical rules.

capture.route: same marked pavement route and same start/turnaround/end points for every subject
capture.instruction: walk at a comfortable natural pace while pushing the bicycle
capture.cable_tie: same mounting position and equivalent contact geometry; record replacement if changed
capture.recorder: same recorder/microphone mounting position and recording settings
capture.turnaround: turn at the marked endpoint and swap handlebar position before the return leg
capture.handlebar_order: record outward and return positions explicitly; study design should counterbalance order across subjects where possible

analysis.movement_proxy_note: Spoke timing reflects wheel motion / forward movement rhythm and is used as a gait-related movement proxy; it is not direct heel-strike or toe-off timing.

change_control: Once participant data collection starts, do not alter detector settings, spoke count, primary comparison window, or extraction rules for only some participants. If a method changes, reprocess all participants with the same version.
